thesis: Seed-stage startups whose software or services improve the operational efficiency, administration, or workflow of health care delivery organizations.
targetCustomer: Health care providers, payers, and ancillary operational teams that run day-to-day care delivery or administrative functions.
inclusionCriteria: Software or services targeting back-office, clinical operations, scheduling, billing, or supply-chain workflows within health care
Solutions addressing scheduling, staffing, revenue cycle, patient flow, or compliance for care delivery organizations
Tools that automate administrative, clinical workflow, or facility operations tasks for health care providers and payers
exclusions: Pure clinical or biomedical research, drug discovery, or therapeutic development companies
Consumer health, wellness, fitness, or direct patient-facing apps without an operations focus
Medical devices, diagnostics hardware, or laboratory instrumentation vendors
Health insurance plan providers and large incumbent enterprise health IT platforms
queries: clinic scheduling and patient flow software
revenue cycle management for medical practices
